idea-plugin.name: Editor Browser
idea-plugin.description:
Websites as editor tabs, right next to your files.

  • One tab per site: Tools › Open URL in Editor Tab… opens localhost:3000, backend.test/admin or any address as a normal editor tab; Tools › New Browser Tab opens a blank one to type into.
  • Splits like a file: right-click the tab › Split Right for code and site side by side.
  • Back, forward, reload, an address bar, zoom (handy in a narrow split) and DevTools in every tab; the page's own favicon becomes the tab icon.
  • Links that open a new window (target="_blank") open as a new tab.
  • Tabs come back after a restart on the page you left them; logins are shared by all tabs.
  • Right-click a selected URL in code › Open in Editor Tab.
  • Starting a dev server opens it as a tab automatically, both from a run configuration (its printed localhost URL) and from the Terminal (npm run dev, php -S, … on a common dev-server port such as 5173, 3000 or 8000); toggle this under Settings › Tools › Editor Browser.

Uses PhpStorm's own embedded Chromium (JCEF). Free and open source on GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.2

  • Right-click › View Page Source works: it opens the page's HTML in a new tab (it did nothing before), and that tab reopens as source after a restart.

0.2.1

  • A globe button in the main toolbar opens a New Browser Tab in one click.
  • Dev servers started in the Terminal open as a tab too: a common dev-server port (5173, 3000, 8000, 8080, …) starting to listen is noticed within a couple of seconds.
  • Restarting a dev server reloads its tab; 127.0.0.1 and localhost count as the same server.
  • The shortcuts are ⌥⇧⌘T / ⌥⇧⌘U on macOS (the docs said ⌃⌥⇧).

0.2.0

  • New Browser Tab: a blank tab with the address bar focused, from the Tools menu, a tab's right-click menu, a toolbar button, or ⌥⇧⌘T (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T on Windows / Linux).
  • The page's own favicon becomes the tab icon.
  • A run configuration printing a localhost URL opens it as a tab automatically (reusing the tab on a restart); toggle under Settings › Tools › Editor Browser.

0.1.0

  • First release: browser tabs in the editor, address bar, back / forward / reload, zoom, DevTools, new-window links as tabs, tabs restored after a restart.
